package.name: mabel_gateway
package.description: App-facing teleop gateway for MABEL on the real robot. Runs the standalone teleop server (server/, the same WebSocket wire protocol + MJPEG/UDP video + multi-client arbitration the Vision Pro / iOS / web apps already use) with the ROS plant selected (MABEL_DISPATCH_TARGET=real:ros): the gateway hosts the controller against a MuJoCo mirror and publishes the canonical command contract that the mabel_*_hardware drivers consume. Video stays out-of-band (MJPEG/UDP), not over ROS.
